text: {"lessons":["My account value has moved up and down despite making few trades; short-term fluctuations alone are not a reason to change course.","Selling Stock B and Stock E at gains felt satisfying, but realized gains are not proof that selling was the right decision; I should judge trades by future prospects and portfolio fit.","Buying more of every stock after selling winners added exposure without a clear signal. I should make deliberate, diversified decisions rather than trade to act or respond to recent price moves."]}
